ios._comment_appBoundDomains: Deliberately false. When true, WKWebView refuses every request to a domain not listed in WKAppBoundDomains, which silently blocked the narration audio hosted on GitHub - playback fell back to on-device speech with no error. Declaring the hosts instead is not workable: release downloads redirect through changing CDN hostnames, and the list is capped at ten.

CapacitorHttp._comment: Routes fetch through native. Needed because the narration audio is served by GitHub as application/octet-stream with Content-Disposition: attachment, which iOS refuses to play in a media element, and which fetch() cannot read either because that host sends no CORS headers. Going native sidesteps both.
